streak.note: 48 keys use serie, 0 keep streak; the archived guide left this to review and the catalog settled it. The widget display name is 'Serie de focus' (widgets.streak.displayName); the how-to pick step must not name it (OnboardingWidgetsStepTests).

streak_freeze.note: 6 keys; the one hit is paywall.benefit.streak.detail 'O înghețare câștigată', whose comment also says a freeze covers one day, not two.

task.note: 31 keys say sarcină, 19 under focusTask.* and plan.* say activitate for the same thing (focusTask.alert.deleteTask.title vs .message is one alert with both). Hits in onboarding.screenTimePermission.* and screenTimeReport.noDataExplanation mean 'activity data' and are correct; alignment of the 19 is its own follow-up batch.

restricted_list.note: Four shipped forms: blocate 1 (plan.createToDo.removeRestrictedApps), de restricții 2, restricționată 4, de aplicații restricționate 2. Chosen for plain wording: 'blocate' is what happens and 'Blocare aplicații' is already the welcome eyebrow. Alignment of the other 8 keys is a follow-up batch; the owner may flip this before the first ro batch.

time_value_disclaimer.note: 10 keys vs 1 (widgets.monthlyTimeValue.description). The four sibling source sentences keep their own single ro form, listed in references/voice-card.md '## Money frame'.

hourly_rate.note: 8 keys say tarif orar, 19 use tarif. One hit: screenTimeReport.missingWage 'câștigul pe oră', which is also a money-outcome word. The badge name 'Salariat' (achievements.badge.salaried.name) is a metaphor, not the rate.

goal.note: 35 keys, 0 hits; forbidden list is preventive.

minute_unit.note: common.durationMinuteUnit is 'min'; spaced '%lld min' in 9 keys (14 units), tight '%lldmin' in 4 width-limited widget and report lines (screenTimeReport.durationMinutesOnly, widgets.streak.focusedInStreak, widgets.streak.focusedMinutesSummary, moneyfesting.details.timeElapsedFormat). Exception: share.duration.minutesShort keeps the bare '%lldm' pending a share-card render. A bare 'm' anywhere else is a finding.

screen_time.note: Apple's ro name for the feature; 19 keys, 0 keep the English. Generic 'timp de ecran' (4 keys, e.g. insights.savings.estimateExplanation) means hours on screen and stays.

Save.note: second person as shipped on paywall.onboardingSubscription.annualPlanBadge (Economisești 56%); the guide's imperative Economisește lost to the catalog

open.recommended_reason: Plain Romanian that a reader without English understands at first read, and the catalog majority (concentr* in 72 keys against focus* in 30). Prefer 'sesiune de focus' only if the platform-term harvest shows iOS ro names the system Focus mode 'Concentrare' and the two would be confused.
open.note: Archived guide section 7 prefers 'sesiune de focus'; the catalog has 3 keys with 'sesiune de focus' and 2 with 'sesiune de concentrare' (term_audit, snapshot 2026-09-15); across all ro copy the stem 'concentr*' appears in 72 keys against 'focus*' in 30 (whole-word 'focus' in 29); the same-source group 'Focus' renders as Focus (insights.focus.title, profile.sessionDetails.splitFocus) and Concentrare (profile.home.focusSection). Decide before the first ro batch; a flip is a global term change with its own follow-up batch, never a per-string choice.

open.recommended_reason: The forecast line and the month-end figure are heard one after the other (VoiceOver names each dashed chart point, then the month-end label), so they need two different words; 'Prognoză' is the everyday word for a forecast and leaves 'Estimare' for the month-end figure ('Estimare la final de lună').
open.note: Shipped split 3/3: 'Estimare' in insights.savings.forecast, monthEnd and focusHistoryEstimateExplanation; 'Proiecție' in estimateExplanation, measuredEstimateExplanation and insights.appUsage.permissionDescription. Whatever is chosen, the forecast line and the month-end figure stay distinct; reconcile the two 'Proiecție:' prefixes in the same follow-up batch.
